decision_basis: Round2 utility did not generalize; deterministic original-router teacher is highly learnable by MLP but poorly fit by the current four-angle Born ansatz. Local pair-specific risk beyond expert energy is small and consistent; train-global pair structure is weak. First address the representation bottleneck before function-weighted boundary adaptation.
target: Centered negative log teacher probabilities, same as round2 positive controls. Frozen original experts and same cached pre-expert input.
new_models: RY(a), CZ chain, RY(b) with eight data angles; paired no-CZ product version; classical affine-amplitude Born. Three seeds and 4000 steps each.
reference_models: Read-only round2 MLP, four-angle entangled Born and four-angle product Born positive controls; all three seeds retained.
fairness: Exact same minibatches, initial LayerNorm and input projection, optimizer, steps, teacher and internal-dev checkpoint selection. Actual trainable counts:10313 for either re-encoding model,10385 for affine Born/MLP; counts alone do not match representable manifolds. Same train-only functional expert assignment for the paired re-encoding models.
mechanism: Two product RY encodings collapse to four summed angles when CZ is removed. Interleaving CZ can expose additional probability directions. Twelve prespecified random-point Jacobian checks have rank8 with CZ and rank4 without, with normalization and exact product-collapse checks.
selection_policy: All new methods and all seeds reported. No search over architectures or coefficients after validation. This is an adaptive research round informed by prior observations, not a fresh confirmatory holdout. Test remains reserved.
provisional_progress_criterion: On internal-dev, re-encoding improves score R2 and top4 agreement over the old four-angle model in all3seeds and also improves over no-CZ paired control. Inspect the absolute gap to MLP and affine Born before proceeding. Full sparse reweighting CE/KL and measured overhead are separate acceptance requirements for any deployment candidate.
planned_followup: Replay each frozen new and reference checkpoint, sparse reweighting through the same expert bank, utilization and BF16/FP16 input-roundtrip at original FP32 arithmetic. Time each sequentially if GPU sharing permits interpretable measurements. Retain negative runs and avoid training a nominal winner.
smoke: All3methods, seed17,4steps, CPU; finite probabilities/gradients, nonzero parameter updates, saved checkpoint replay passed. Formal configuration separate.
